why: A guard that needs its input to exist before it refuses anything turns a missing value into full access.
bad:
if (ids.length > 0 && !ids.includes(siteId)) return forbidden();
if (CRON_SECRET && header !== expected) return unauthorized();
good:
if (!ids.includes(siteId)) return forbidden();
if (!CRON_SECRET) throw new Error('CRON_SECRET unset');
